yt_title: Why Does Water Spin Down The Drain? (Not What You Think) #Shorts
desc: Why does water spin down the drain? The idea that Earth's rotation sets the direction in a sink is a myth. The effect is far too weak, and leftover motion in the water decides the spin. New fizzy fact every day on Fruit Soda.
caption: Does your sink spin the way you thought? 🌍 Comment YES or NO if you believed the myth. Follow for a fact every day.

lines.text: Why does water spin down the drain? Not the reason you think.
People say Earth's spin makes sinks swirl one way in each hemisphere.
That force is called the Coriolis effect, and it is real for hurricanes.
But in a sink it is far too weak to beat everything else.
The swirl comes from tiny leftover motion in the water and the shape of the basin.

v.s: and the shape of the sink

lines.text: Fill a smooth tub, wait until still, and it can spin either way. Test it yourself.
